content.title: Are supermarkets open on Easter Sunday? Depends where you shop. See the list
content.text: Need a last-minute ingredient for your Easter gathering? Take note: Some supermarkets in South Florida are closed for the holiday.Although Publix is closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, Winn-Dixie, Milam’s and other grocery stores are open. Convenience stores and gas station minju-marts are generally open as well.Here’s a look at what supermarkets in Miami-Dade and Broward are open or closed on Easter: Milam’s Market at 11701 South Dixie Hwy. in Pinecrest has its Easter display up well ahead of the April 6, 2026, holiday. Milam’s markets around South Florida will be open on Easter. Howard Cohen hcohen@miamiherald.com Publix: Closed.Walmart/Sam’s Club: Walmart stores will be open regular hours; Sam’s Club closed.Costco: Closed.Target: Closed.Winn-Dixie: Open regular hours.Aldi: Closed.Milam’s Markets: Open regular hours.Sedano’s Supermarket: Open.Presidente Supermarket: Open.Price Choice Supermarket: Open; but some locations may close at 2 p.m.BJ’s Warehouse Club: Open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.The Fresh Market: Open regular hours.Whole Foods Market: Most stores in South Florida open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., but several will close at 6 p.m., including the Pinecrest area location at 7930 SW 104th St.Trader Joe’s: Open.Sprouts Farmers Market: Open.Here are the malls that are open or closed on Easter:PharmaciesDrug stores, which also sell food items, are generally open on Easter but check with yours for the hours:CVS: Open.Walgreens: Open.
